local: of the genuine warm-hearted nature of these Northeasterners, these snow people.
ja_pron: Korera no Tōhoku-jin, yuki no hitobito no kokoro kara no atatakasa mo aru kara desu.
native: of the genuine warm-hearted nature of these Northeasterners, these snow people.

zh: 雪鄉人民的工作環境已改變，但傳統的生活方式

local: Every year during this heavy snow solar term, the temperature will drop to below 30 degrees
ja_pron: Maitoshi kono taisetsu sekki no aida, kion wa mainasu 30-do ika ni sagarimasu.

local: Celsius, and the outdoors become a neutral freezer.
ja_pron: Sesshi-do de, okugai wa shizen no reitōko ni narimasu.
native: Celsius, and the outdoors become a neutral freezer.

zh: 把它拿回室內食用。

ja_pron: Sore o shitsunai ni mochikaette tabemasu.
native: take it back indoors to come.

zh: 他們最喜愛的食物之一是美味的冷凍海豚魚。
ja: 彼らが最も好む食べ物の一つは美味しい冷凍イルカです。
local: Among the food they favour the most is the delicious frozen dolphin.
ja_pron: Karera ga mottomo konomu tabemono no hitotsu wa oishii reitō iruka desu.
native: Among the food they favour the most is the delicious frozen dolphin.

zh: 冷凍海豚魚內部形成蜂巢結構，這有助於它吸收其他食材的香氣，
ja: 冷凍イルカは内部にハニカム構造を形成し、これが他の食材の香りを吸収するのに役立ちます。

native: of other ingredients quicker and makes the flavour richer.

native: twists of fate.
